name: CI Sport
old_description: CI Sport holds over 300 collegiate licenses and wants to work with you! We offer the latest styles of garments and unique designs.
about:
CI Sport traces its roots to Fargo, North Dakota, where in the late 1980s entrepreneurs Randy Thorson and Warren Ackley launched a screen-printing startup to supply decorated uniforms and souvenirs to local bars and restaurants. The business formally established its corporate division, CI Apparel, in 1990 and has since grown into a national supplier of licensed and custom-decorated apparel.

Today the company operates three divisions—CI Sport for collegiate licensed goods, CI Apparel for custom corporate wear, and CI Tourism for resort and tourism designs—from a 73,000-square-foot facility in southwest Fargo that opened in 2020. The plant houses all decoration production in-house, including embroidery (12-piece minimum, over 1,000 thread colors) and screen printing (36-piece minimum, PMS color matching), plus digitizing, art creation, inventory management, and e-commerce fulfillment for more than 25 online clients. The company also installs concept shops and t-shirt towers that serve over 700 college bookstores across 49 states.

Its customer base spans collegiate retail (bookstores, arenas, sporting-goods stores), professional sports leagues such as the NHL and NBA, minor-league baseball and hockey venues, corporate clients across virtually every industry, and tourism operators. CI Sport holds more than 300 collegiate licenses and works with major licensing companies, while also distributing brands like Nike, OGIO, and Columbia.

The founders started the business to meet a hospitality-industry need for decorated uniforms, and the company says its differentiating factor is the rare complete in-house facility that controls every step from art to finished goods. Low minimum orders (12–24 pieces depending on division) and fast turnaround times are cited as key advantages for corporate and tourism accounts.
